newsitem.title: UK: Seven-year gilts at a premium on UK gilt repo mkt.
newsitem.headline: Seven-year gilts at a premium on UK gilt repo mkt.

text.p: The UK gilt repo market had a quiet day, with interest centring on the 8.0 percent gilts due 2003 out to one month.
Trade for the two-week period was reported at 4-1/4 percent and there was also interest in the month.
The 7.0 percent gilts due 2001, which were quoted at 35 to 40 points through general collateral (GC) levels on Wednesday, were still in demand but at a more modest premium.
There was litle impetus from the cash market, where the Bank of England provided assistance totalling 684 million stg after forecasting a shortage of 700 million.
Overnight cash was quoted at 5-3/4 5/8 in late business, well down from Wednesday's late quotes around 6-1/2 percent or even seven.
